title: Diagnosing Gurgling Drains and Vent Failures
description: When fixtures gurgle or drain slowly, the root cause often extends beyond a simple clog. Vent pipes allow air to enter the drainage system, equalizing pressure so wastewater flows smoothly by gravity. If a roof vent becomes blocked by leaves, nests, or ice, negative pressure builds up behind discharging water. This vacuum steals water from fixture traps, causing slow drainage, gurgling sounds, and dangerous sewer gas odors inside the building. Professional troubleshooting starts by checking whether multiple fixtures are affected simultaneously, which typically points toward a main vent stack issue rather than a localized fixture blockage.
